## Change
What problem does this solve, and what behavior changes? Link relevant issues/design notes.

## Validation
List build/test commands and results, platform/configuration, and any runtime or two-player checks. State checks not run and remaining limitations.

## Review checks
- [ ] Documentation/settings reflect implemented behavior and unfinished features.
- [ ] Hook, version-gate, save, or networking risks are explained where relevant.
- [ ] Diff contains no generated binaries/packages, game files, private keys, or personal settings.
- [ ] Research/dependencies have cited sources and permission considerations.
